shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone slab/monolith
anthropomorphic figure occupying the full field
justification: Both show low-relief carving on an upright slab dominated by a single vertical anthropomorphic composition with a broad headdress-like top and a patterned lower field, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a seated/standing figure with elaborate curvilinear ornament, glyph-like blocks and a serpentine element at the base, whereas B shows an austere, geometric scheme of stacked chevron/herringbone bands flanking a plain central shaft with narrow relief arms — quite different motifs, proportions and rendering conventions.
